body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex.
Round 1: 5 Cursor specialists + generic Codex. Accepted 3 findings (doc drift, folded inline: test-codex-implementer.md, SECURITY.md, docs/linting.md).

## Rejected Code Review Findings
### [Code Review] Cursor-Structure (round 1)
**Finding**: larch-logs manifest status "in-progress" in committed artifact.
**Reason not implemented**: Expected mid-run larch-log behavior; updated at Step 18.

### [Code Review] Cursor-Structure (round 1)
**Finding**: Positional argv assertions in test are brittle.
**Reason not implemented**: Intentional mechanical contract; acceptable trade-off per plan.

### [Code Review] Multiple reviewers (round 1)
**Finding**: $PWD might not equal git toplevel if launcher is invoked from a subdirectory.
**Reason not implemented**: Pre-existing cwd contract guarantees this; same invariant applies to -C "$PWD" which already existed.

### [Code Review] Multiple reviewers (round 1)
**Finding**: larch-logs run artifacts in the diff are unrelated runtime data.
**Reason not implemented**: Normal larch run-log commits; not a bug in code under review.
